LanguageData.AutoHuntTip: Non-pregnant animals will be chosen first from oldest to youngest, followed by pregnant animals from least to most progressed.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipForceHunt: Cause this animal to be hunted down to the specified limits, regardless of current nutrition levels and target.\n\nThis may cause other auto hunted animals to be hunted less depending on food needed, but if the nutrition level is set high enough this setting does nothing.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipLabel: The animal to be automatically hunted.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentTotal: The current number of wild animals, both male and female.\n\nAnimals that auto-hunt has marked previously but aren't being hunted are not included in this total.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipMaxTotal: The maximum number of wild animals, both male and female.\n\nHunters will automatically hunt any extras.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentMales: The current number of wild males of breeding age.\n\nAnimals that auto-hunt has marked previously but aren't being hunted are not included in this total.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentMalesYoung: The current number of wild baby and juvenile males.\n\nAnimals that auto-hunt has marked previously but aren't being hunted are not included in this total.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipMaxMales: The maximum number of wild males of breeding age.\n\nHunters will automatically hunt any extras.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipMaxMalesYoung: The maximum number of wild baby and juvenile males.\n\nHunters will automatically hunt any extras.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentFemales: The current number of wild females of breeding age.\n\nAnimals that auto-hunt has marked previously but aren't being hunted are not included in this total.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentFemalesYoung: The current number of wild baby and juvenile females.\n\nAnimals that auto-hunt has marked previously but aren't being hunted are not included in this total.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipMaxFemales: The maximum number of wild females.\n\nHunters will automatically hunt any extras.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipMaxFemalesYoung: The maximum number of wild baby and juvenile females.\n\nHunters will automatically hunt any extras.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentPregnant: The current number of wild pregnant animals.\n\nAnimals that auto-hunt has marked previously but aren't being hunted are not included in this total.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipAllowHuntPregnant: Allow pregnant animals to be hunted along with other females of the same species.
LanguageData.AutoHuntTooltipSetLimit: Click to set an animal count limit.
